derivation: Operation A completed and routed to B inside one unjoined branch, B completed and discharged the branch obligation, and the sibling obligation remained open. The later record shares A's provider-native operation identity and differs in content, so LIFE-010 classifies it CONFLICTING and LIFE-006 fixes the reason set to CONFLICTING_EFFECT. A is completed, so LIFE-013's dependency rule runs and the affected set is A together with every transitive descendant, which here is the completed B. The discharged obligation's completion frontier is B, which is in that set, so the obligation becomes DISPUTED and the pass can never join in this candidate. Both completed rows and their selected routes remain historical; LIFE-013 does not rewrite earlier permission or completed routing. The open sibling obligation is untouched.
